claims.claim: Body, engine n suspension for all model of honda, acura n toyota cars n suvs
claims.evidence: Witness shows a single headlight unit only; no evidence of multi-brand/multi-model universal fit, and such universal fitment is implausible for a single part.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy
claims.evidence: The only brand marking visible in the photo is an overlaid watermark reading 'HONDA AND ACURA', not Toyota; no Toyota marking or OEM logo is reported on the part itself.

claims.claim: No crack, all clips and brackets complete
claims.evidence: Witness explicitly lists cracks, fogging, and clip/bracket condition as not shown or confirmed in the photos.

risks.risk: Mismatch between seller's claimed brand (Toyota) and the only brand text associated with the image (Honda/Acura watermark), suggesting a stock photo or misrepresented listing.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the part with any OEM logo, part number sticker, or stamped brand marking on the housing itself.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified generic aftermarket part, worst case, not as genuine Toyota OEM

risks.risk: Unknown make/model/year fitment despite seller claiming universal compatibility across three brands.
risks.proof: Close-up of the part number etched on the lens or housing, cross-checked against a fitment chart.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unconfirmed-fit part, worst case requiring buyer-side verification

risks.risk: Hidden internal lens damage (cracks, fogging, moisture) not visible from the given angle.
risks.proof: A photo with the headlight illuminated from behind, and close-up shots of the lens interior from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if lens integrity is unconfirmed, worst case

risks.risk: Condition of electrical connectors, bulbs, and wiring harness not shown.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the connector plug and bulb sockets, ideally a clip of it being plugged in and lighting up.

risks.risk: Left/right side designation unknown, which affects correct pairing and price.
risks.proof: A photo showing the full assembly orientation relative to a badge or the vehicle, or a visible L/R stamp.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unconfirmed side, worst case treated as unmatched single unit

risks.risk: Mounting clips/brackets claimed complete but not verifiable.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all mounting tabs and clips from the rear of the housing.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if clips/brackets may be missing or damaged

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any OEM logo, part number, or stamped marking on the housing or lens.
Photo of the headlight powered on (bulb lit) to confirm electrical function.
Close-up of the rear mounting tabs, clips, and electrical connector.
Photo showing left/right orientation relative to the vehicle or a visible L/R marking.
A photo without the watermark or a video pan to confirm the item is not a reused/stock image.
response.reason: The seller's claim of an original Toyota part contradicts the only brand indicator in the report (a Honda/Acura watermark), and the implausible claim of fitting all models of three different brands raises strong scam indicators.
